title: Collision Warning and Collision Avoidance System - Overview
introduction:
The forward collision warning system gets the driver’s attention through sight and sound. I think of that pairing as a tap on the shoulder with a voice attached: the visible warning and audible chime communicate a collision risk.

Use this overview to recognize those outputs and understand which module provides each. Its scope is warning identification; it does not describe detection methods, automatic braking, driver-response instructions or diagnostic tests.

edits.text: How the Collision Warning Alerts You

The forward collision warning system alerts the driver to a collision risk with a red warning LED (light emitting diode) indicator bar above the instrument panel and an audible warning chime from the IPC. The indicator bar is part of the HUD (head up display) module.
edits.why: I keep the visible and audible outputs distinct when reading this description: the bar belongs to the HUD module, while the chime comes from the IPC. The alert communicates a collision risk; this overview alone cannot establish whether the system also intervenes.
